name: smwmusic-ultimate-doom-dark-halls
title: Ultimate DOOM - Dark Halls
description:
My custom port of Dark Halls from DOOM featured in GPW2. This is not a 1:1 port of the original music but rather my rendition of it. I added some additional atmospheric elements that weren't present in the original.

This track is more moody and atmospheric, good for lava cave or tense levels.
